description: Two Claude-side mechanical nudges for the fusion-parametric-design doctrine: a blocking gate on the Fusion MCP execute tool (process-spawning constructs are always refused; oversized ad hoc scripts are refused unless they carry the shipped lane tooling's report-protocol signature), and a warn-only reminder when Write/Edit targets ordinary-modeling artifact smells (fusion-project.json, DESIGN-STATE.md, transactions/, verification reports) outside the skill's own tree. The doctrine text is the cross-harness authority; these hooks fail open on their own confusion.
